method: field scan of attributes.status and attributes.active across all feature chunk files
notes: status values inService / inPlanning / decommissioned / unknown are authoritative for scale claims in the master report
unknown corresponds to attributes.status null in the feature export (11 records)
active=1 count (214233) differs from inService (214073); document both — do not treat active flag as a substitute for status
inService + inPlanning = 297500 active/planned deployment records used for detection-exposure framing; decommissioned excluded from reachability studies
